name: Task Format Bridge
changes: The Pro notice for folder migration reports now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Apply makes one editor change, so one undo in the note restores the previous task text.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Task Format Bridge is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your tasks in order.

related.name: Task Field Labels
related.blurb: Show text labels for dates, priority, and recurrence in rendered tasks.

related.name: Task Date Links
related.blurb: Add a daily note link to a task when you complete it.

related.name: Bases Task Rows
related.blurb: Show each checklist task in the notes of a base as its own row, with due dates and tags.
